technology.text: Assumed that all methyl chloride used in Switzerland origins European production plants. Emission values for storage and handling from chloroform production from a U.S source. For the infrastructure as approximation tank infrastructure for methanol or fuel was used .

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Representativity of the assumed transport distances and the used modal split was not determined. No imports from Oversea included.
